text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific antidotes for rosuvastatin are known. Hemodialysis does not significantly enhance clearance of rosuvastatin. Contact Poison Control (1‑800‑222‑1222) for latest recommendations.

10 OVERDOSAGE No specific antidotes for rosuvastatin tablets are known. Hemodialysis does not significantly enhance clearance of rosuvastatin. In the event of overdose, consider contacting the Poison Help line (1800-222-1222) or a medical toxicologist for additional overdosage management recommendations.
